svg.title: CANopen Diagnostics overview
svg.desc: Make CANopen traffic and heartbeat state readable while checking normal operation of a marine control and monitoring module through a PC-based test setup. Flow: CAN frames; Decode identifiers; Track heartbeat state; Review event evidence
